Petition for Order
This letter is our
The Attorney General has no authority under the Public
Records Disclosure Law, ORS 192.410 !! seq. to grant your peti­tion.
Your petition •request[s) the Attorney General to order
Union County, its agents and employees, to produce copies of the
following records. • • • The Attorney General has no jurisdic­tion
to order a county governing body to disclose county
records.
ORS 192.450(1) grants the Attorney General the power to
order inspection of public records of a state agency. For the
purposes of the Public Records Disclosure Law, a county
governing body is not a •state agency.• Compare ORS 192.410(1)
with ORS 192.410(2). A person denied inspection or copying of
records of a public body other than a state agency should peti­tion
the appropriate local district attorney for an order
granting disclosure. ORS 192.460. Procedures for judicial
review of a district attorney's public records order are set
forth in ORS 192.460, 192.465(2) and 192.490. See also, ORS
192.480 (outlining procedure for review of electea official's
denial of diaclosure).
Bruce E. Anderson
